title: Wakana Gojo, 15 Years Old, Teenager
overview: Wakana helps Marin make a bunny girl outfit so she can cosplay as one of her favorite characters.

title: You Can Equip Boobs
overview: Marin and Wakana go to a cosplay event and meet another cosplayer named Amane Himeno.

title: I Wuuuuv Slice-of-Life Scenes! ♡♡♡
overview: Amane tells Marin and Wakana about his past and how he got into cosplay.

title: Has All My Measurements Memorized
overview: Marin represents her class enters the school beauty pageant and finds out she gets to cosplay.

title: 800 Million
overview: Wakana and Marin finish up the suit for the Rei-sama cosplay but Wakana realizes something is missing.

title: I'll Make It Happen, No Matter What with These Two Hands
overview: Wakana finishes up Marin's suit for her Rei-sama cosplay and the day of the beauty pageant finally arrives.

title: Capture Those Delicious Memories!
overview: Marin discovers the terrifying truth that she's gained weight and her cosplay no longer fits her.

title: The Only Way I Can Think of to Express That Gratitude Is With Money
overview: Marin and Wakana go to a cosplay event. Marin meets up with Amane and Suzuka and Wakana meets up with Akira.

title: Because I Don't Intend to Sleep Tonight
overview: Marin tries to convince Juju to join their "Coffin" cosplay group.

title: So We're Gonna Do It All Right Now?!
overview: Marin has a slight misunderstanding and Wakana has his first playthrough of "Coffin."

title: I Didn't Think Anything Good Would Ever Happen to Me
overview: Everyone is getting ready for the upcoming Coffin group cosplay but they also have a surprise for Juju.

title: Dear My Dress-Up Darling
overview: Marin, Wakana, and the others finally have their "Coffin" group cosplay session.
